newsitem.title: USA: Puget Power says outages still spreading.
newsitem.headline: Puget Power says outages still spreading.

text.p: Puget Sound Power and Light Co, based in Bellview, Wash., said around 156,000 of its customers were without power as of early Friday, with the number rising due to ongoing storm conditions.
"It is getting worse, not better. Tree limbs are still falling on power lines," said a Puget Power spokeswoman.
She noted that several 150 to 230 kilovolt transmission lines were out of service along with about 25 substations, but power generation facilities have not been affected.
The storm hit the Northwest on Thursday, causing transportation delays along with the power outages.

Puget Power had no estimate for how long the outages will continue. "It depends on the storm. This morning it has picked up again," said the utility spokeswoman. "We are telling people to prepare for Sunday or even Monday."
